title: A tested package, a fair budget and a 90-day plan
course_title: Training-of-Trainers (ToT): Teach Adults and Build Trainers

say: A tested package, a fair budget, and a 90-day plan.
This is the video for module four of the Training-of-Trainers course.
A trainer who hands over a complete, tested package that others deliver well is even more valuable than one who runs a good session.
The heart of it is the trainer guide, with session plans, timings, and key messages marked core or flexible.

say: The post-test average is only 6.0 out of 10, below her target of 7. Most women got the moisture questions wrong, and the demonstration was hard to see from the back.

say: So she runs the demonstration in three small groups, and gives moisture checking 20 more minutes of practice.

say: A second pilot gives 7.8 out of 10. Only then does she train 15 trainers.

say: Partners do not buy sessions. They want changes in what people can do. So start with the need, then your SMART objectives.

What participants will be able to do
How we will know it worked
About the trainer: one past result

say: Explain how you will train, and how you will know it worked: reaction, pre and post test, and a follow-up check.

say: Then the cost, and one result from a past training. For example: after training, 17 of 20 traders could complete a daily sales record, up from 2 before.

say: Here is a worked example. Kemi is asked by a cooperative in Abeokuta to train 25 members for one day. The venue is free. All prices are approximate.
Printing is 25 times 800, which is 20,000 naira. Refreshments are 25 times 1,500, which is 37,500.
Her own fee covers a preparation day as well as the delivery day: 2 times 25,000, which is 50,000.
With flip chart and markers at 10,000, a co-facilitator at 15,000, and 5,000 for follow-up calls, the subtotal is 137,500.
She adds a 10 percent contingency for price changes: 13,750.
Total: 151,250 naira, or 6,050 per participant. She quotes about 151,000 and shows exactly what each amount covers.
Agree in writing what you will deliver, the dates, payment terms and the report. Then send the report on time, even when results are mixed.

say: For example, Blessing in Port Harcourt delivers her training twice to 20 women each, recording test data.

panel.heading: A realistic 90 days
items: Days 1 to 30: deliver twice to 20 women each

say: Next, she selects six trainers by clear criteria and runs a two-day ToT with microteaching.

panel.heading: A realistic 90 days
items: Days 1 to 30: deliver twice to 20 women each

say: Each trainer runs one session of about 15 women. Blessing observes three and calls the others. New trainers drift most in their first sessions.

say: At day 90 she reports reach, results and next steps. That is about 130 women, with quality checks at every level.

say: To remember. Test your guide on someone new. Pilot before you scale. Cost everything, including preparation and follow-up, plus a contingency. Show problems and improvements honestly. And plan 90 days: deliver, multiply, follow up, report.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Test the guide on someone who missed the ToT
Pilot and revise before you scale
Deliver, train trainers, follow up, report

say: Now assemble your package, write a proposal and budget, and complete your self-assessment and plan. The certificate needs real capstone evidence and at least 70 percent in the final quiz.
